P1_B_logreg.role: REFERENCE (6-feature B logistic, no EW column)
P1_B_logreg.definition: LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=1000) on the 6 frozen B features
P1_B_logreg.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on base_train ONLY, one scaler per fold
P1_B_logreg.calibration: block sigmoid (1-D unpenalized logistic of y on logit(p)) fit on the calibration sub-block ONLY - the 60 PA-bearing calendar days [cal_first..cal_last] per fold, derived at runtime (cal_last = max game_date <= train_end; cal_first = cal_last - 59 days). RAW and CAL lanes BOTH output, BOTH labeled, reported separately.

P1_H3_pitcher_ew_only.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on base_train ONLY, one scaler per fold
P1_H3_pitcher_ew_only.calibration: identical block sigmoid on the 60 PA-bearing-day calibration sub-block; RAW + CAL lanes separate

P1_H3_batter_ew_only.definition: 7 features = the 6 B_logreg features + exactly one EW-90d column (ew_batter); unchanged fitting/calibration procedure (see P1_B_logreg)
P1_H3_batter_ew_only.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on base_train ONLY, one scaler per fold
P1_H3_batter_ew_only.calibration: identical block sigmoid on the 60 PA-bearing-day calibration sub-block; RAW + CAL lanes separate

config.fold_calibration_rule: cal_last = max game_date <= train_end; cal_first = cal_last - 59 days (60 PA-bearing calendar days); derived at runtime; UNCHANGED from the executed first-run-v1 procedure
config.shared_populations: identical rows/labels across all candidates: the per-fold eval identity hash (sha256 over sorted (game_pk, at_bat_number, batter)) is asserted identical for every candidate; one loaded frame supplies y to every candidate; no per-candidate population differences

evaluation.bootstrap: paired slate-date bootstrap, block-stratified, row-weighted num/den ratio; ONE draw stream shared across candidates; pooled dev = the 3 dev folds ONLY

lanes.RAW: PRINCIPAL lane: all registered intervals, contrasts and family claims are computed on pred_raw
lanes.CAL: reported SEPARATELY as derived point estimates (no CIs, no contrast claims); never merged with RAW

evaluation.multiplicity_rule: family of 4 predeclared contrasts. Registered reporting rule: report each contrast's ORDINARY (unadjusted) 95% percentile interval AND the Holm-adjusted family result SEPARATELY; any family-level claim across the 4 contrasts must come from the Holm-adjusted result, never from the ordinary intervals.
evaluation.no_search: no hyperparameter search, no half-life search, no feature-set search beyond the 4 registered candidates; the 4 contrasts are the only registered comparisons

hypothesis_test.amendment: C3.8, registered 2026-10-15 (EXPERIMENT_CARD.md section C3.8 + this section); additive amendment only - candidates, inputs, folds, seed, n_boot and output destination are UNCHANGED
hypothesis_test.scope: the 4 predeclared RAW Brier contrasts only (C1_pitcher_ew_vs_B, C2_batter_ew_vs_B, C3_both_vs_pitcher_only, C4_both_vs_batter_only), each as a SIGNED RAW Brier difference (numerator arm minus denominator arm exactly as registered in evaluation.contrasts_predeclared)
hypothesis_test.estimand: fold aggregation = the EXISTING block-stratified row-weighted pooled dev estimand (sum of per-row Brier contributions / count of rows over all pooled dev rows, dev blocks 2024H1/2024H2/2025H1 only); the observed contrast delta_j is the difference of the two candidates' pooled RAW Brier point estimates on the identical shared rows

resampling.design_verification: the resampling design SUPPORTS this inference and is verified: the resampling unit is the SLATE DATE (game_date) and the fold aggregation is the block-stratified row-weighted pooled estimand; both are explicitly identified and appropriate for the dependence structure - within-slate cross-row dependence is absorbed by resampling whole dates (multinomial over each block's original date count), block composition is fixed by block-stratified draws so block weights cannot shift across replicates, and the row-weighted num/den pooling keeps the replicate statistic on the same per-row scale as the point estimate
resampling.scheme: the EXISTING paired slate-date bootstrap, block-stratified, row-weighted num/den ratio, n_boot=2000, seed=20261001; the per-block date draws depend only on (blocks, dates, n_boot, seed), so ONE draw stream is shared across candidates AND contrasts; contrast replicate deltas are differences of candidate replicate statistics under the SAME draws
resampling.paired: paired resampling shared across candidates and contrasts is a registered requirement of the test

test.name: NULL-CENTERED APPROXIMATE BOOTSTRAP TEST
test.label: approximate centered-bootstrap test, NOT an exact randomization test; NO finite-sample-validity guarantee
test.definition: for each contrast j with observed delta Delta_j and bootstrap replicate Delta*_jb: centered errors e_jb = Delta*_jb - Delta_j; two-sided p_j = (1 + sum_b 1{|e_jb| >= |Delta_j|}) / (B + 1) with B = n_boot = 2000; the >= keeps ties in the numerator; the B + 1 denominator is the finite-resample correction
test.multiplicity: Holm step-down across the 4 RAW Brier contrasts at family level 0.05 (monotone adjusted p-values); the ordinary percentile CIs remain explicitly UNADJUSTED; log loss and CAL lanes are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (no test, no claim)

hypothesis_test.implementation: comparison.py: HYPOTHESIS_TEST_CONTRASTS, null_centered_p_value, holm_adjust, null_centered_contrast_test; synthetic tests in harness/test_null_centered.py

config.output_write_once_note: write-once: run_comparison refuses to overwrite an existing output dir (WriteOnceError). The harness creates <output_destination>\<64-hex harness run_id>\ and records this batch_id as run_label.
